title: A Compact Stance-Indexed Anterior-Posterior COP Representation for Parkinson's Disease Classification from Plantar VGRF
abstract: arXiv:2609.22956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parkinson's disease alters gait and bilateral coordination, but machine-learning performance also depends on how continuous gait signals are represented. This study investigates whether preserving anterior-posterior center-of-pressure (AP-COP) information at fixed locations across normalized stance provides a compact and informative representation of plantar-force gait signals. Bilateral vertical ground reaction force recordings from 165 participants in the Gait in Parkinson's Disease Database were evaluated using repeated fully nested participant-level cross-validation. We propose AP-COP10, comprising AP-COP position and bilateral asymmetry across five stance windows. AP-COP10 achieved an AUC of 0.894 and outperformed three harmonized literature-derived COP representations under the same evaluation pipeline. translated_title: 一种基于站立期索引的紧凑前后向压力中心表示方法：用于基于足底垂直地面反作用力的帕金森病分类
translated_abstract: 帕金森病会改变步态和双侧协调性，但机器学习的性能也取决于连续步态信号的表示方式。本研究探讨在归一化站立期的固定位置保留前后向压力中心（AP-COP）信息，能否为足底力步态信号提供一种紧凑且信息丰富的表示。研究使用重复的完全嵌套参与者级别交叉验证，对来自“帕金森病步态数据库”中165名参与者的双侧垂直地面反作用力记录进行了评估。我们提出了AP-COP10，其包含五个站立期窗口内的AP-COP位置和双侧不对称性特征。AP-COP10达到了0.894的AUC，并在相同的评估流程下优于三种经统一处理的文献来源COP表示方法。互补的25个非AP-COP描述符单独使用时达到了0.856的AUC，而完整的35特征表示则达到（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本研究提出AP-COP10这一紧凑表示方法，通过在归一化站立期的五个固定窗口中提取前后向压力中心位置及双侧不对称性特征，实现了基于足底垂直地面反作用力的帕金森病分类，AUC达0.894，优于文献中已有的COP表示方法。
en_tdlr: This study proposes AP-COP10, a compact representation capturing anterior-posterior center-of-pressure position and bilateral asymmetry across five stance windows, which achieves an AUC of 0.894 for Parkinson's disease classification from plantar vertical ground reaction forces, outperforming harmonized literature-derived COP representations.
